newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TIBS sees poorer annual result.
newsitem.headline: TIBS sees poorer annual result.

text.p: Bus and taxi company TIBS Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it did not expect its results for full-year 1996 to be as satisfactory as the previous year.

TIBS said in a statement its Singapore $1.6 million first-half net loss for the six months to June 30, 1996, announced earlier, came mainly from its bus companies which suffered a S$3.58 million loss.
The loss was due to an increase in operating costs arising from depreciation charge on 384 new buses and higher manpower costs due to a salary adjustment in July this year, it said.
It said profits from non-bus companies fell 46.1 percent to S$1.97 million, largely due to a slowdown in the electronics industry and higher production costs.
